metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that can help get rid of lower back pain at night.

Two main causes of low back pain at night comes from muscle tightness and weakness that affects us while we sleep. This video will be broken up into to two parts to target this to give both quick and long-lasting relief.

To get the best results, go through both parts and use what gives you the best results.

Watch now and fix lower back pain at night and sleep better! 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:02 3-Way Hip Stretch
4:49 Frog Rocker
6:49 Cobra-Scorpion
9:25 Daily Strengthening Exercise
